# Restore pre-push test-cache mirroring (`mirror_suite_cache`) in the canonical wl hook template

discovered-from:CG-0MW1VJRY6001FOPT

## Problem statement

The dev-push gate's test-cache mirroring exists only in this repository's
committed `.githooks/pre-push` and in a stale, gitignored local build of the
`worklog` package — never in the canonical `PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT` template on
`ContextHub` `dev`. The capability therefore survives only until someone
rebuilds `dist` from `dev` or runs `wl doctor upgrade --confirm`, either of which
silently removes it, and the "landed on `dev` ⇒ green cached full-suite entry at
that commit" invariant breaks for every worktree-originated push.

A previous implementation (commit `8f40463d`, merged) restored the function and
the documentation but left the template source untouched; an audit
(2026-11-04) therefore returned **not ready** — AC1 partial, AC2 partial, AC4
unmet. This brief re-scopes the item to the actual remaining work: land the
upstream template change, pin it with tests on both layers, and remove the false
green that is masking the hazard.

## Users

- **AI agents running `/skill:implement`** rely on a `dev` push from a linked
  worktree leaving a green cached full-suite entry the post-push verification can
  read, instead of `missing`.
- **Auditors / audit F3** auto-verify execution-dependent ACs ("full suite
  passes") from that cache entry instead of re-running an 18–21 min suite.
- **Maintainers of any repository consuming the hook template** (`wl init`,
  `wl doctor upgrade`) expect scaffolding and upgrades to deliver the documented
  mirroring behaviour, not to delete it.

Example user stories:

- "As an agent finishing a work tree, when the pre-push gate runs the full suite
  from my linked worktree, I expect the main checkout's
  `run_tests.py --summary --suite all --json` to report that commit green."
- "As a maintainer, when I rebuild the globally linked `wl` from `dev` and run
  `wl doctor upgrade --dry-run`, I expect `pending: []` and every hook
  `up-to-date`, with no repository-local patch keeping the capability alive."

## Context: what `mirror_suite_cache` is

Not a separate suite — it is step 5 of the v3 `pre-push` hook. After the
full-suite gate goes green on a `dev`/`main` push, it copies cache entries the
gate run wrote into the main checkout's `.worklog/cache`.

- Cache location (`~/.pi/agent/skills/test_cache.py:480-503`):
  `<repo>/.worklog/cache` when `.worklog/` exists, else `<git-dir>/test-cache`,
  else `.test-cache`.
- Keys are content-addressed (`cache_key`, line 506): sha256(normalised command
  + `compute_git_state()`, line 222 = HEAD sha + content of every dirty path), so
  an identical key is an identical run and copying a missing key is always safe.
- Why needed: `implement.py finish` pushes from the linked worktree holding the
  pushed commit (`SA-0MVTFMB7K002Y1F3`). A worktree has no `.worklog/`, so the
  run lands in `<git-dir>/test-cache`, invisible to the main checkout, where
  `run_tests.py --summary` and audit F3 read.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Canonical template carries the capability.** `PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT` in
   `../ContextHub/src/doctor/hook-upgrade.ts` contains `mirror_suite_cache` (the
   function plus its post-green invocation), and ContextHub's committed
   `.githooks/pre-push` is byte-identical to it. Commit `9771d9c9`
   (`WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP`) is rebased onto `ContextHub` `dev`, builds cleanly and
   is pushed to ContextHub `dev` — **no** repository-local patch in this repo.
2. **No divergence after a global `wl` refresh.** With the refreshed `wl`
   (`cd ../ContextHub && npm run build` on `dev` — the package is npm-linked and
   `dist` is gitignored; `npm link`/`npm i -g` only if the global link is
   absent), running `wl doctor upgrade --confirm` from this repository leaves
   `wl doctor upgrade --dry-run --json` reporting `pending: []` and all five
   hooks `up-to-date`. Because `core.hooksPath = .githooks`, this is byte
   equality between `.githooks/pre-push` and the installed template.
   The refresh gap in `../SorraAgents` `scripts/install_pi.sh` (it wires hooks
   but never refreshes the `wl` it depends on) is recorded as a follow-up work
   item, not fixed here.
3. **Worktree pushes stay visible to the main checkout.** A `dev` push from a
   linked worktree (the `implement.py finish` path) leaves a green full-suite
   cache entry in the **main checkout's** `.worklog/cache` for that exact commit,
   so `run_tests.py --summary --suite all --json` reports a green (not `missing`)
   entry. Re-verify after the template change; the current state is only green
   because of the stale `dist`.
4. **Behaviour is pinned on both layers.** (a) The upstream template test in
   ContextHub (`tests/pre-push-hook-gate.test.ts`, the mirroring + fail-soft
   assertions shipped in `9771d9c9`) passes against the landed template. (b) A
   TCE-side test in `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold-hook-gate.test.ts` runs the
   **committed** hook from a linked worktree and asserts a green run's cache entry
   appears in the main checkout's cache with the `mirrored cache entry <name>`
   log line, and that an unmirrorable entry only warns
   (`warning: could not mirror cache entry`) without failing the push.
5. **Documentation attributes the behaviour to the canonical template.**
   `docs/DEVELOPER.md` and the implement skill's dev-push-gate step describe the
   mirroring as template behaviour, and `../ContextHub/docs/migrations.md`
   documents it in the hook section (delivered with `9771d9c9`).
6. **All related documentation is updated** to reflect the changes, including
   code comments, `README`, and any relevant wiki or docs-site entries.
7. **The full project test suite passes** with the new changes (and the changed
   scope passes before each commit).

## Constraints

- The capability must not exist as a repo-local divergence: `wl doctor upgrade`
  must report zero pending changes, so any hook edit lands in the template first.
- The mirror stays **fail-soft**: no copy failure may fail a push, and it never
  overwrites an existing entry.
- `--gate-commit` binding of the gate is **out of scope** (blocked follow-up
  `CG-0MW2151GL003SV5E`); so is the hardened `hook_dir="$(CDPATH= cd -- …)"`
  wrapper form (behaviourally equivalent; recorded on this item's history).
- `install_pi.sh` global-`wl` refresh is out of scope (follow-up item).
- Cross-repo pushes go to each repo's `dev` only, never `main`.

## Existing state (re-verified 2026-11-04T20:25Z, plan session)

- **AC1 is now met upstream.** `9771d9c9` is an ancestor of `ContextHub` `dev`
  (`git merge-base --is-ancestor 9771d9c9 dev` exits 0), and
  `grep -c mirror_suite_cache ../ContextHub/src/doctor/hook-upgrade.ts` returns 2
  (the function plus its post-green invocation). `../ContextHub/.githooks/pre-push`
  is byte-identical to this repo's `.githooks/pre-push` (`diff` clean) — no
  repository-local patch.
- **AC2 is now met (no longer a false green).** The installed `wl` resolves to
  `../ContextHub/dist`, whose `doctor/hook-upgrade.js` was built at 16:03, after
  the landed `src` (15:56); `wl doctor upgrade --dry-run --json` from this repo
  reports `pending: []` and all five hooks `up-to-date`.
- **AC4 is still unmet — the only outstanding capability gap.** The upstream
  template test exists (`../ContextHub/tests/pre-push-hook-gate.test.ts`,
  mirroring + no-overwrite + fail-soft, ~lines 296-408) but
  `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold-hook-gate.test.ts` has no mirroring
  assertion ("mirror" appears only in a comment at line 20).
- **AC3 needs re-proof, not new code.** The committed hook still carries
  `mirror_suite_cache` (`.githooks/pre-push:90`, invoked after a green gate at
  :150), but the worktree-push mirroring has not been re-verified since the
  template landed; the item's own `dev` push is the natural evidence.
- **AC5 is met.** `docs/DEVELOPER.md` ("Dev-push gate and test-cache mirroring")
  and the implement skill's dev-push-gate step both attribute the mirroring to
  the canonical `PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT` template; `9771d9c9` carries
  `../ContextHub/docs/migrations.md`.
- The audit of 2026-11-04 (`rgardler`) returned **not ready** (AC1 *partial*,
  AC2 *partial*, AC4 *unmet*); AC1/AC2 have since been satisfied upstream, so
  the remaining work is AC4(b) plus re-proof of AC3.

## Desired change

Land the upstream template change (rebase, rebuild, test, push to ContextHub
`dev`), refresh the global `wl`, confirm zero hook divergence, add the TCE-side
committed-hook test, and align the documentation — leaving the capability owned
by the canonical template.

## Verification commands (copy-paste ready)

```bash
# AC1/AC2 — land upstream, rebuild the linked wl, prove zero divergence
cd ../ContextHub && git rebase dev wl-WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP-pre-push-cache-mirror
cd ../ContextHub && npm run build
cd ../Tableau-Card-Engine && wl doctor upgrade --confirm
cd ../Tableau-Card-Engine && wl doctor upgrade --dry-run --json   # pending: [], all up-to-date

# AC3 — worktree push leaves a green entry in the main checkout's cache
python3 $(skill_path test)/scripts/run_tests.py --summary --suite all --json   # green at the pushed commit

# AC4 — both layers
cd ../ContextHub && npx vitest run tests/pre-push-hook-gate.test.ts
npx vitest run --project unit tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold-hook-gate.test.ts
```

## Key Files (predicted)

- `../ContextHub/src/doctor/hook-upgrade.ts` — `PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT` gains
  `mirror_suite_cache` + its post-green invocation (from `9771d9c9`).
- `../ContextHub/.githooks/pre-push` — committed hook kept byte-identical to the
  template (ContextHub's own doctor self-check enforces this).
- `../ContextHub/tests/pre-push-hook-gate.test.ts` — template behaviour test
  (mirroring + fail-soft), from `9771d9c9`.
- `../ContextHub/docs/migrations.md` — hook-section documentation.
- `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold-hook-gate.test.ts` — new TCE-side cases
  against the committed hook (mirror entry + fail-soft warning).
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — "Dev-push gate and test-cache mirroring" wording
  confirmed/updated to name the canonical template as the source.
- `skill/implement/SKILL.md` (SorraAgents) — dev-push-gate step wording.
- `.githooks/pre-push` — unchanged (must remain byte-identical to the template).

## Risks & assumptions

- **Latent hazard until AC1 lands**: any `npm run build` in `../ContextHub` on
  `dev` removes the function from the template; the next
  `wl doctor upgrade --confirm` overwrites the committed hook. Mitigation: land
  `9771d9c9` first, then rebuild.
- **Branch may have drifted**: `9771d9c9` was dropped once by a ContextHub `dev`
  reset; the rebase may conflict in `src/doctor/hook-upgrade.ts` and
  `.githooks/pre-push`. Git is the recovery path (the branch retains it).
- **False-green verification**: AC2/AC3 must be checked after a *rebuild from
  `dev`*, not against the current stale `dist`.
- **Each `dev` push runs a full suite** (~18–21 min via the gate), so verification
  cost dominates.
- **Scope-creep risk**: adopting the newest hook wholesale (`--gate-commit`,
  hardened wrappers) is deliberately excluded; record as linked items only.
- Assumption: `WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP` is the ContextHub home for this change, and
  `SA-0MW20Y5YI004QS3M` for the implement-skill wording.
- Assumption: the push transport may need the HTTPS + `gh` credential-helper
  workaround on this host (SSH key not registered on GitHub); no persistent
  config change.
- Assumption: `npm run build` is run on a clean `ContextHub` `dev` checkout; a
  dirty or non-`dev` tree would rebuild the wrong template.
- Assumption: ContextHub keeps its own committed `.githooks/pre-push`
  byte-identical to the template (its doctor self-check compares the two), so
  landing `9771d9c9` must update both.
- Risk: the TCE-side test can pass while the upstream template test fails (and
  vice versa); AC4's two halves must both be reported, never one for the other.

## Plan (2026-11-04, plan skill — stage `plan_complete`)

The remaining work is small (one test file, one verification pass, one
bookkeeping record), so the decomposition is a single vertical phase with no
further phasing: the capability itself already landed upstream, and every AC is
now either met or satisfied by one of the three children below.

Children (test-first order):

1. **Pin pre-push cache mirroring in the committed-hook test** (`CG-0MW2KEFMA000YY66`, task) — AC4(b):
   add the mirror / no-overwrite / fail-soft cases to
   `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold-hook-gate.test.ts`, run against the
   **committed** hook. No change to `.githooks/pre-push` (byte-equality with the
   template is a hard constraint).
2. **Verify zero-divergence and worktree cache mirroring end-to-end** (`CG-0MW2KEXFZ0080BP7`, task) —
   AC1/AC2/AC3 re-proof with recorded evidence: template ancestry + byte-equality,
   a rebuild of the npm-linked `wl` from `dev`, `wl doctor upgrade --dry-run
   --json` → `pending: []`, the item's own worktree `dev` push logging
   `mirrored cache entry …`, and `run_tests.py --summary --suite all --json`
   green at the pushed commit. Depends on child 1 (the dev push runs the full
   suite, which must include the new pin).
3. **Record the install_pi.sh global-`wl` refresh gap as a follow-up** (`CG-0MW2KF710003IUEZ`, chore) —
   AC2's tail clause: file the gap as an `SA-` item in `../SorraAgents/.worklog`
   and reference it from this item, deliberately **not** as a child/blocker here
   so it never gates this item's closure.

**Coverage-review note.** `apply_coverage_review` advanced the stage to
`plan_complete` but also auto-created five lexical "Close coverage gap" stubs
(`CG-0MW2KGNZ9001EA9B`, `CG-0MW2KGOET006AARR`, `CG-0MW2KGOUV006U4ZU`,
`CG-0MW2KGPAV002H1PE`, `CG-0MW2KGPRJ005QTMW`). Each restated a parent AC already
covered by one of the three children above, so all five were closed as
duplicates (reasons recorded on each) — the decomposition stays at three
children.

**Plan: changelog (2026-11-04, plan skill, session
`herdr-1793823012-2636769-3809`).**

- Refreshed *Existing state*: AC1 and AC2 are now satisfied upstream
  (`9771d9c9` is an ancestor of `ContextHub` `dev`; `dist` rebuilt from it;
  `wl doctor upgrade --dry-run --json` → `pending: []`, all five hooks
  `up-to-date`); AC4(b) remains the outstanding capability gap.
- Added this Plan block and three children (test-first order) with one dependency
  edge (`CG-0MW2KEXFZ0080BP7` depends on `CG-0MW2KEFMA000YY66`).
- Extended `CG-0MW2KEXFZ0080BP7` with explicit documentation ACs (AC6/AC8) so the
  parent's AC5 and AC6 are traceably covered.
- Closed five auto-created coverage stubs as duplicates (see above).
- Appendix: added Q7-Q9 (agent decisions recorded, producer may override).
- Effort/risk: reused the existing estimate (Small / High,
  `CG-C0MW2JWMKX006UBGA`) — the remaining scope is smaller than when it was
  measured, but the push-verification cost and cross-repo surface are unchanged.

Vertical-slice decision: no additional phasing. Each child is independently
deliverable and ends in a verifiable state (green unit tests; recorded command
output; an existing follow-up id). The only shared artifact is the hook itself,
which is read-only for all three.

Out of scope, unchanged from Constraints: `--gate-commit` binding
(`CG-0MW2151GL003SV5E`, blocked), hardened `hook_dir` wrapper form, and any
`install_pi.sh` edit.

Effort/risk: reuse the existing estimate (Small / High, `effort_and_risk_skill`
comment `CG-C0MW2JWMKX006UBGA`, 2026-11-04T16:08Z) — the scope has shrunk
(AC1/AC2 landed upstream) but the push-verification cost and the cross-repo
surface keep the risk level; no re-estimate is warranted for a re-plan of the
same remaining work.

## Related work

(find-related report on this item; overlaps verified by AC comparison)

- `CG-0MW1VJRY6001FOPT` (completed) — the `wl doctor upgrade` run that replaced
  the committed hook with the canonical template and dropped the capability.
- `CG-0MW2151GL003SV5E` (blocked) — `--gate-commit` binding; deliberately out of
  scope here.
- `CG-0MW0SC8O7009RYJ6` (completed) — full-suite gate rollout to
  `tce-main-street`, the consumer of the same hook.
- `CG-0MUFIBB2X008A136` (completed) — `implement.py finish` pushing from the
  stale main checkout; the worktree-push change that made mirroring necessary.
- `WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP` (ContextHub) — the upstream template change.
- `SA-0MVTFMB7K002Y1F3` (SorraAgents) — push from the tree being pushed.
- `SA-0MW20Y5YI004QS3M` (SorraAgents) — implement-skill documentation.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- **Q1 (round 1, earlier intake)** — "Scope of the template change: (a) full
  sync with the newest hook, (b) mirror-only, (c) full sync plus wrapper
  hardening?" — Answer (producer, via recorded assumption): **(b) mirror-only**.
  Evidence: comment `CG-C0MW214R59009AX29`; `--gate-commit` captured as
  `CG-0MW2151GL003SV5E`.
- **Q2 (round 1)** — "Where are the cross-repo edits tracked?" — Answer:
  **their own stores** — ContextHub `WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP`, SorraAgents
  `SA-0MW20Y5YI004QS3M`. Evidence: comment `CG-C0MW214R59009AX29`.
- **Q3 (round 1)** — "Documentation surface?" — Answer: **(a)** `docs/DEVELOPER.md`
  + implement skill + ContextHub `docs/migrations.md`. Evidence: same comment.
- **Q4 (round 2)** — "How should AC2 express the mechanism that makes the
  installed `wl` current? (a) documented `npm run build` refresh + follow-up for
  the `install_pi.sh` gap, (b) extend `install_pi.sh`, (c) drop the mechanism
  clause." — Answer (producer, interactive): **(a)**. Evidence: verified
  `wl` is npm-linked to `../ContextHub` and `dist` is gitignored; the installer
  gap becomes a follow-up item.
- **Q5 (round 2)** — "Where does AC4's pinning test live? (a) TCE-side only,
  (b) ContextHub-side only, (c) both." — Answer (producer, interactive):
  **(c) both**. Evidence: `9771d9c9` already ships the upstream test
  (`tests/pre-push-hook-gate.test.ts:349-408`); the TCE case is new.
- **Q6 (round 2, producer-requested detail)** — "What is the mirror suite and why
  does it exist?" — Answer (agent, evidence-based): see *Context: what
  `mirror_suite_cache` is* above; sources `test_cache.py:222/480-517`,
  `.githooks/pre-push:80-150`, `SA-0MVTFMB7K002Y1F3`.
- **Duplicate check** — performed (`wl search` over `mirror_suite_cache`,
  `test-cache mirroring`, `cache mirroring`, `doctor upgrade`, `pre-push`): no
  item fully covers these ACs; overlaps are the related items listed above.

- **Q7 (round 3, plan session)** — "Should the fail-soft case be skipped when the
  suite runs as root?" — Answer (**agent decision, not producer-confirmed**;
  producer may override): yes, mirror the upstream `it.skipIf(isRoot)` guard
  (plus the Windows skip), because directory permissions cannot deny the copy as
  root and a forced-failure hack would test the fixture rather than the hook.
  Evidence: `../ContextHub/tests/pre-push-hook-gate.test.ts:346` (`isRoot`) and
  its `never fails the push when a cache entry cannot be mirrored` case.
- **Q8 (round 3, plan session)** — "Where does the `install_pi.sh` refresh-gap
  follow-up live, given it must not gate this item?" — Answer (**agent decision,
  not producer-confirmed**; producer may override): as an `SA-` item in
  `../SorraAgents/.worklog`, referenced from this item and deliberately **not** a
  child/blocker here. Rationale: follows the round-1 Q2 precedent (cross-repo
  work is tracked in its own store) and keeps AC2's "not fixed here" literal
  without making this item's closure depend on a framework installer change.
- **Q9 (round 3, plan session)** — "Should the two met-but-stale ACs (AC1, AC2)
  be reworded now that the template landed?" — Answer (**agent decision**): no
  rewording; the ACs already describe the end state, and only the
  *Existing state* section was stale. It has been refreshed with the verified
  2026-11-04T20:25Z state, including the audit's own evidence trail.
- **Round 3 question volume:** no producer-blocking questions were raised — the
  brief's prior Appendix (Q1-Q6) settles every scope choice, and the two open
  choices above were decidable from recorded precedent.

Parent: CG-0MW2151GL003SV5E (TCE consumer side of the commit-bound pre-push gate).

# Consumer test: shipped hook forwards `--gate-commit` from a linked worktree

## Goal

Pin the TCE-side, observable behaviour of the canonical commit-bound pre-push
gate **before** the upgraded template is adopted, so adoption is verified
behaviourally rather than by inspecting the hook text.

Extend `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold-hook-gate.test.ts`, which already
scaffolds a throwaway game repo with a linked worktree and a stubbed
`run_tests.py`. The stub must record `sys.argv[1:]` and be able to emit gate
provenance (`run_tests: gate-root <path>`) on stderr, so the forwarded flags
and the mirror source are both observable.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT` captures the pushed `<local_sha>` for each gated ref (`refs/heads/dev`, `refs/heads/main`) while still reading pre-push stdin **once**, and invokes the resolved runner as `--scope full --strict-git-env --json --project-root <repo_root> --gate-commit <sha>`. Portable runner resolution is preserved: repo-local `skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py` first, then `$HOME/.pi/agent/skills/test/scripts/run_tests.py`; neither present remains a hard fail (never a silent skip).
2. After a green gate, the cache mirror uses the checkout the gate **actually resolved** (the runner's `run_tests: gate-root` stderr provenance), not merely the push cwd, so the entry lands in the main checkout's `.worklog/cache` for the commit that was validated.
3. Behavioural tests pin the behaviour in ContextHub: the stub runner observes `--gate-commit <pushed sha>` and `--project-root` for a dev/main push, no `--gate-commit` for non-gated refs, the multi-commit refusal blocks the push, and the mirror copies from the gate-resolved root. The committed `.githooks/pre-push` byte-matches the template (`wl doctor upgrade --dry-run --json` reports `pending: []`, every hook `up-to-date`).
4. A push to a non-gated ref (e.g. `refs/heads/feature/x`) starts no suite: the stub marker file is never written.
5. A push carrying two gated refs with different commits is refused before any suite runs: the push fails non-zero with a message listing each `ref=sha` and the recovery options (one commit per push, `TEST_SCOPE_SKIP=1`, `git push --no-verify`).
6. A deletion push (all-zero `local_sha`) is not treated as a gated commit: the suite is not invoked for it.
7. After a green stub whose stderr emits `run_tests: gate-root <other-root>`, the hook mirrors the cache entries into the main checkout cache belonging to `<other-root>` — proving the gate-resolved root, not the push cwd, is the mirror source.
8. The file's existing assertions (green push, red push blocks the ref, worktree-managed `GIT_DIR` accepted) still pass unchanged, and the file runs green via `/skill:test --type unit` at the commit under review.

> ACs 1-3 restate the parent ACs this child verifies; the ContextHub-side
> template and behavioural-test authoring is tracked in `WL-0MW2A3NAP0088IE9`
> (producer decision Q2 = (a)), so this child pins the *consumer* behaviour.

## Minimal implementation

- Extend the stub runner to export its argv and to echo a configurable
  `run_tests: gate-root <path>` / `gate-subject <sha>` on stderr.
- Parameterise the push helper over the pushed ref and the number of gated refs
  so multi-commit and non-gated cases reuse the same fixture; add an all-zero
  deletion case and a "no runner present" case (isolated `HOME`, no repo-local
  runner).
- Add a fixture variant where the gate-root points at a second clean checkout,
  to assert the mirror destination.
- Keep the tests temp-dir / `file://` / stub based: no network, no
  `npm install`, no browser.

## Dependencies

- `WL-0MW2A3NAP0088IE9` (ContextHub: template + committed hook + behavioural
  tests) — these assertions are red until the upgraded template lands and the
  TCE hook is regenerated.
- Adopted in practice by the sibling "Adopt commit-bound template" child.

## Key Files

- `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold-hook-gate.test.ts` (extend)
- `tests/scripts/` (fixture helpers, if extracted)
